source.title: Liebherr Technical data - Mobile crane LTM 1050-3.1 [m/t] (linked from liebherr.com product page)
source.page: 12 (load chart, table ref t_185_00011_00_001 / t_185_00111_00_001); dimensions p.3; supporting forces & hook blocks p.9; remarks p.29

notes: Values read from the official Liebherr metric datasheet (upper table on p.12: 360°, 9 t). Each boom length (except 11.4 m) has two columns in the datasheet: the standard capacity and a '**' telescopable-load column (capacity while telescoping under load); only the standard column is stored here. For 11.4 m the datasheet has a '* over rear' column (50 t at 3 m, 41.3/34.1/29/24.5/16.8 t at 4-8 m) and a 360° column; the 360° column is stored, so the top-left value is 42 t, not the 50 t rated max (50 t is over-rear only). Datasheet remark 10: capacities above 42 t only with additional pulley block. Capacities at the smallest radii for 16.7 m and some other lengths increase with radius (e.g. 16.7 m: 24.7 t @3 m, 26.5 @4, 27.8 @5) - this is as printed in the datasheet (boom-angle limited), not an extraction error. Datasheet remark 5: weight of hook block/hooks is part of the load and must be deducted from the lifting capacities (hook block 50 t = 0.40 t, 46.1 t = 0.40 t, 30.2 t = 0.28 t, 13.3 t = 0.195 t, hook 4.5 t = 0.075 t). Outrigger span taken from the dimension drawing p.3: longitudinal 7151 mm (4526 + 2625 between outrigger centrelines, a separate chain 4274 + 2895 = 7169 mm is also shown), transverse 6400 mm fully extended (4500 mm intermediate; 2339-6400 mm with VarioBase option). The load chart pictogram shows full outrigger base but does not print the dimension. Max supporting force Fmax: 295 kN (30 t) and 420 kN (42.8 t) for two outrigger pictograms on p.9; 42.8 t recorded. Operating weight not stated for full 9 t counterweight crane-operation; datasheet gives on-road <= 36 t (3 x 12 t axle loads, 7 t counterweight) and jobsite driving <= 40 t (3 x 13.3 t, 9 t counterweight). Max counterweight 9 t (7 t basic + 2 t additional). Max lifting height 54 m (with folding jib) and max radius 44 m per cover page; main-boom-only max hook height not printed as a number (only graphically), so left null. Lifting capacities to ISO 4301-1 crane group A1, given in metric tons, radii from slewing centre, telescopic boom capacities apply with folding jib removed. Also captured but not stored: 11.4 m over-rear column values listed above. DIMS (added 2026-09-24 from the dimension drawing p.3 of the same source PDF): overallLength_m = carrier length (bottom dimension chain); axle positions and slew centre are cumulative sums of that chain from the carrier front; height = column A, width = column B for standard 385/95 R 25 (14.00 R 25) tyres. wheelDiameter_m is a nominal value computed from the tyre designation (not on the drawing). Boom pivot height/offset not dimensioned (null). Slew centre 425 mm behind axle 2 (checks with the 3292 mm slew-centre-to-rear dimension). Tail radius R = 3530 mm at the counterweight; R = 4070 mm reaches a lightly drawn (optional) rear item. Overall length 12.391 m incl. that item / 11.830 m without. Dimension reference corrected: the datasheet's bottom dimension chain starts at the front of the boom head (transport position, boom overhanging the cab), not at the carrier front bumper. overallLength_m is now the carrier length (front bumper to rear) and axlePositions_m / slewCentreFromFront_m are measured from the carrier front bumper; the boom head overhang ahead of the bumper is stored as boomOverhangFront_m = 2.358 m (overall transport length incl. boom = 11.613 m). Evidence (dimensions drawing p.3): bottom chain 2358 | 2788 | 2750 | 1650 | 2067 = 11613 with separate 9255 carrier dimension; slew centre 425 behind 2nd axle.
